**New York, NY -** In the ever-evolving landscape of fintech and artificial intelligence, one name stands out for his visionary leadership and ethical innovation: James Carter, the Founder and CEO of Firefly Star LLC.
Based in New York, Carter has devoted his career to breaking down the barriers of institutional finance, bringing Wall Street-grade tools to everyday investors around the globe.

With a professional journey that began on Wall Street and a mission centered on financial democratization, Carter is spearheading a revolution in AI-powered trading systems -- one that emphasizes accessibility, transparency, and integrity.
Born in Boston, Massachusetts, James Carter was raised in a family steeped in academia and engineering.
His early fascination with logic and innovation led him to write his first lines of code at the age of 12.
By high school, he was immersed in macroeconomic theory, setting the stage for a future in quantitative finance.
Carter earned his Bachelor's degree in Applied Mathematics and Economics from Harvard University in 2005.

His thirst for deeper knowledge led him to Columbia University, where he completed a Master's in Financial Engineering, focusing on the use of machine learning in financial modeling and risk analysis.
Carter's professional path began at Goldman Sachs, where he joined the Global Investment Research division in 2006.
Over six years, he rose to a senior leadership role in algorithmic trading, contributing to major advancements in options pricing, volatility forecasting, and real-time trading systems.
In 2012, he moved to Morgan Stanley as Director of AI & Electronic Trading.
There, he led pioneering efforts to embed machine learning into live trading platforms, improving execution efficiency by 12% for high-volume institutional clients.

In 2021, driven by the belief that world-class financial tools should not be exclusive to institutional elites, Carter began assembling a team in New York to explore new frontiers in AI-driven finance.
After four years of development and testing, Firefly Star LLC was officially launched in January 2025.
The company aims to provide everyday investors with access to powerful, institutional-grade trading infrastructure--regardless of geography or wealth.
Today, Firefly Star serves users in over 40 countries, with fiat currency gateways active in Brazil, Mexico, Colombia, Turkey, and Nigeria.
The company is licensed as a Money Services Business (MSB) by the U.S. Financial Crimes Enforcement Network (FinCEN) and is independently audited by KPMG.
These technologies enable high-frequency trading with built-in risk controls, giving investors the power to trade confidently in volatile markets.
Looking ahead, the company plans to launch the Firefly DeFi Ecosystem in 2026--introducing decentralized governance through DAOs and tokenized incentives for users.
Carter is more than just a fintech entrepreneur -- he is a global voice for AI ethics and financial inclusion.
He is a sought-after speaker at international forums and has been featured in Business Insider and FinTech Weekly for his thought leadership on model transparency and decentralized compliance.
Carter's leadership is deeply values-driven.
He believes that success is not defined by money or titles, but by the impact one has on others.
He cites Ed Mylett as a major influence, admiring his commitment to integrity, service, and uplifting others.
Outside of business, Carter is a passionate long-distance runner, a strategic chess player, and a dedicated mentor.
He lives in New York City with his wife and two children and actively volunteers with nonprofits that promote financial literacy and AI ethics among underserved youth.
James Carter represents a new wave of fintech leadership--one that blends cutting-edge innovation with a commitment to social good.
Through Firefly Star LLC, he is not just changing how people invest -- he's transforming who gets to participate in the financial future.
